sourceDoc: Font Pool v5 -- Open-First Channel Combinations (user-supplied decision doc, 2026-09-11; supersedes v4/font-pool-v4-channel-combinations.md, which is not checked into this repo).
note: Central typography catalog. Supersedes this file's own prior v0.1.0 'data collection only' state -- Font Pool v5 is an active decision document, not a collection pass. Typography onboarding for OTHER channels beyond what v5 explicitly names is still deferred per the portfolio-wide rule (ROADMAP.md Phase 2, docs/ONBOARDING-ORCHESTRATION.md); v5 is itself the user's own explicit, documented exception opening typography for the channels listed in channelCombinations below, on an open-license-first basis. Commercial/licensed font BINARIES are never copied into this repo -- only family names, roles, statuses, and verified source locations are recorded.

statusModel.READY_OPEN: Open-license font with a verifiable source; eligible for renderer registration when a channel needs it. Can appear in a live rendered post.
statusModel.LICENSE_REQUIRED: Commercial/Adobe/foundry font retained as a creative direction. Needs a documented license AND an authorized, renderer-accessible source before activation. Cannot appear in a live rendered post.
statusModel.REFERENCE_ONLY: Useful visual reference, but no usable license/source is available. Not exposed in the channel selector.

metadata.note: Metadata is a recurring functional layer -- source, date, SKU, score, slide number, edition, category, or legal note. Not a rare/display role.

rareOccasionalDisplay.rule: Rare means maximum one focal use in a composition: a cover phrase, section marker, campaign moment, or occasional accent. Must never carry paragraph copy, product facts, medical information, dates, or legal text.

arabicRtl.note: Cairo is the reliable Arabic information/body family. Rakkas is an occasional Arabic display face only. Arabic combinations require real RTL layout and Arabic glyph shaping -- not a substitute for a Turkish/Latin combination.

licenseRequiredCreativePool.note: Visible as future art-direction options; disabled in production until a documented license and an authorized, renderer-accessible source are recorded per family. Adobe Creative Cloud availability alone is not treated as proof of backend embedding or self-hosting rights.

kaduse-medikal.note: Visual system reset (2026-09-16): the prior combinations/utilityMono/kaduseScopedExclusions entries here were part of the removed Kaduse aesthetic typography policy (channel-content-os typography/kaduse-typography-policy.ts, deleted) -- a font-pairing decision, not a font-availability fact. activationContract: Its license permits the intended server-side rendering and artifact output.
A legitimate, stable file source is recorded; no unlicensed web download is acceptable.
Required Turkish and/or Arabic glyph coverage, weights, and italics are verified for the assigned role.
It passes the existing font-resolution and composition-fit path with a real post sample.
guardrails: No commercial font is silently substituted during rendering; the system reports the actual blocked state.
No rare face is used for body copy, medical claims, prices, dates, footnotes, or metadata.
A channel may rotate between combination A and B, but each individual post uses one coherent combination.
This pool is a design inventory; it is not a permission to use every listed font in production.
